scope: Fixed-count original/typed/raw per-tuple MLINESTYLE49 offset reconciliation for styles with no affected emitted MLINE consumers; selected owning transactions and reused AC1027 independent source only.

caveats: This is a narrow readiness baseline, not implementation or per-version/full-document/native qualification.
Source is AC1027 ASCII; target controls cover ASCII/binary. Only the selected first-offset request is exercised.

Caller snapshots cover selected public modeled/common/application/XDATA fields and raw carrier fields and visible retained-lease pointer identity, not every private parser field or all dx_data collections.
The independent ordinary reader can create defaults during document setup; physical checks precede it and added materials remain disclosed.
Known Continuous source empty-description to output Solid line projection is explicit; arbitrary names/provider fields are not normalized.
No consumed-geometry recalculation, cut/fill-gap preservation, count editing or native rendering claim is made.
baseline.note: Retain the old source/object/executable bindings as historical evidence; current rebuilt executables are separately bound below.

implementation: Relax offset equality only in typed/original edit admission. Reconcile ordered original/typed/raw doubles, reject conflicting or nonfinite selections, and preserve signed-zero distinctions and strict fixed count/CMC/reference mirrors.
Rewrite only changed final owning49 slots after scalar insertion through the existing body writer; retain unrelated/application payloads and unchanged numeric spellings.

Compute geometryChanged from the reconciled target. Reuse current ENTITIES/BLOCKS consumer guards, original geometry authority, strict late snapshots, actual-output projection, rollback and corrected retries.
Preserve pre-AC1021 typed-offset refusal and established legacy raw-only behavior. No public API/header/parser/capture/query/observer or DWG byte-layout change.
